definitions.explanation: Clothing that is manufactured in standard sizes and sold in stores, as opposed to garments made to order or custom-tailored.

examples.japanese: {既製服|きせいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{既製服|きせいふく}しか⟦{扱|あつか}っていない→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: This store only carries ready-made clothing.

examples.japanese: {既製服|きせいふく}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: With ready-made clothing, it sometimes doesn't fit your body perfectly.

notes:
A compound of {既製|きせい} (ready-made, prefabricated) and ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (clothing). Refers to mass-produced clothing sold in standard sizes, contrasted with custom-tailored garments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既製服|きせいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ — to buy ready-made clothes
- {既製服|きせいふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧ — ready-made clothing size
- {既製服|きせいふく}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧ — ready-made clothing manufacturer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注文服|ちゅうもんふく}→注文服：20888_chuumonfuku⟧ — custom-made clothing; made to order
- ⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立て：11645_shitate⟧ — tailoring; custom sewing
- ⟦{既製品|きせいひん}→既製品：08304_kiseihin⟧ — ready-made products (broader term, not limited to clothing)
